utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Leo, I'm still planning to bring those extra boards for the roof. Should be a good day for it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Uli. I'll bring the nails.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, Leo. I'll see you Saturday morning, then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Rosa just roped me in for the tool sign-ups—it's a community center repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Rosa? Are you sure? I haven't seen a single flyer or email about this—how is anyone supposed to know?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, Rosa's been handling the promotion herself—maybe she forgot to send out the official notice, but I promise it's happening. I've got the sign-up sheet right here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. When did you want to move the furniture?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that's right, I should've mentioned — the whole drive has moved to Sunday at the community center now. Can you still help out then?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Sunday works fine for me. I'll bring my toolbox and meet you at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, with Gus's toolbox and my blueprints, we'll get this organized. Let's start with Mrs. Chen's fence—it's the most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought the repair drive was for old bikes and appliances—is the fence part of that, or are we switching focus?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The fence is part of it, Hana. I have the plan—it covers both fences, bikes, and appliances, just one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Faye, it's this Saturday from 9 to 4—looking forward to seeing everyone there!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'll be at the community center bright and early Saturday with my toolbox, ready to give that mower a whirl.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Opal! I'll make sure we have a spot set up near the front for your mower project.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So it's Saturday at 9 at the school lot, right? Just making sure I got it right.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday? At the school lot? Oh, right... is that for fixing up old bikes or the broken chairs? I keep mixing those up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Probably both? I think they're taking anything that's broken, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm just catching up—so Jules has a spark plug ready, right? That should cover step two.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard that too. And they're saying we might even finish ahead of schedule if more folks chip in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear. If we can get a few more hands, we could probably knock it out in one afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Vik, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm bringing my toolbox and some spare nails. You're coming on Saturday for the repair drive at the garden fence, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So the repair drive is for the garden fence? I thought it was for household items.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope they've thought about how we're going to transport all those heavy appliances.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's a good point, Pia. I was thinking maybe we could borrow Mr. Henderson's pickup truck if we chip in for gas.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That could work, but do we know if Mr. Henderson even lets anyone borrow his truck?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Tess, is it true they're fixing up old bikes at that drive? I've got one with a busted chain.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, I'm not entirely sure about bikes, but they said 'pretty much anything broken,' so I'd bring it along! Maybe they'll have someone who can fix that chain.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'll definitely bring it then. Thanks, Tess!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I saw something about it on a flyer somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's this Saturday at the school parking lot, starting at 9 AM. I hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice. Maybe I'll bring by that old lamp of mine.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right! Tools. Yeah, that'd be great. Thanks, Gus. I'll take whatever you've got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a new wrench set and a few other things. Want me to swing by later with them?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, sure, swing by whenever. I'll be around... I think.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Dane, good to see you! Just a heads-up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, thanks for letting me know, Rosa. Sunday works for me—I'll make sure I have that spark plug ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Dane! I'll add you to the volunteer list. We'll have coffee and snacks too—see you Sunday!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So it's definitely on Saturday at the school parking lot, right? I'll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Saturday at the school lot. Bring anything that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll see what I can dig up from my garage. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, heard about the repair drive. Want me to grab my toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that'd be great, Gus! I heard it's Saturday at 9 at the school parking lot—they'll probably fix anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, I'll be there with my toolbox. Should I sign up for a specific time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, you hear about the repair drive? I just ran into Vik at the corner store and he said it's really picking up steam now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I've got the blueprints ready and Gus is grabbing his toolbox. We're set to start directing the repairs soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great to hear it's all coming together. I might be able to swing by Saturday and lend a hand if you still need people.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hang on—Quinn mentioned it too, but I still haven't seen any official notice. Are you sure this is actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely sure! I've been coordinating with the school, and we're all set for Saturday at 9 AM in the parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday 9 AM in the parking lot? And this is definitely not just a rumor going around?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Rosa just told me it's for the community center—tools and repairs, not bikes or chairs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good to know it's the community center. But do you remember the exact drop-off times? I want to make sure we don't show up too early or too late.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Let me think—Rosa said the sign-ups start at 9 AM and go until 4 PM, so you should be fine anytime in between.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I'll see you Saturday with those boards for the roof.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Uli! See you Saturday morning. I'll have my toolbox ready for that lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community garden shed and doing some other projects—would love to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm planning to bring my repaired lawnmower and help clear the shed Saturday morning. I already roped Sam into helping me get it ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Opal! Sam's a good helper—between your lawnmower and their elbow grease, we'll have that shed looking brand new in no time!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I heard about it too. Are you planning to bring something in for fixing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I was thinking of bringing in my old bike, the chain keeps slipping.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Think they'll be able to fix a bike chain? Those can be tricky.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Gus! I've got you down for the morning shift—your wrench set is going to have a field day with those projects.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mara, I also heard from Pia that they're still figuring out the exact drop-off times, but I can call the community center later if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be so helpful, Tess! Let me know what you find out, and I'll add it to the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've heard a bit about it from others. What do you think about it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, sorry, I keep getting confused—what repair drive are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, it's the one this Saturday where neighbors fix up old stuff together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: The repair drive is a neighborhood effort to fix up old bikes and appliances—they're collecting spare parts and tools at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Bikes and appliances, right! I've got a rusty toaster that's been sitting in my shed for ages—do you think they'd take that?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so—the drive accepts all kinds of small appliances. Want me to check with Jules to be sure?
